raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_customers stores 4 of its region values as numeric codes ('01'-'04') instead of names, and raw_region_map provides a one-to-one mapping from those codes to WEST/EAST/NORTH/SOUTH. silver_customers passes region through unmapped, so the codes leak into silver and gold_region_daily; translating them through raw_region_map fixes this without changing row counts or the output columns.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(coalesce(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
